decisions.reason: The supplement range draws directly on the firm's consumer health and pharmacy-channel knowledge, so it can read market feedback and keep refining the line.
As an extension of the established Trivital line, the joint product benefits from the firm's existing formulation, regulatory and marketing knowledge, which makes it easy to adapt.
The mushroom-based immune supplement is a niche with limited visibility, but immune products gained relevance after 2020 and it still fits the firm's supplement expertise.

Despite its distance from the core and the 2018 recall, a valsartan generic fits the firm's broad generics portfolio and manufacturing quality capabilities once sourcing is resolved, so dropping it is not clearly preferable.

The OTC triptan uses the firm's prescription-to-pharmacy regulatory and in-house manufacturing knowledge and fits its migraine/OTC positioning, though its distance from the core leaves some uncertainty.
